## Install on Linux

1. Download {zip-name} from this release, picking the file that matches your CPU.
2. Extract it into its own folder: `mkdir vrcft && tar -xzf <archive> -C vrcft`.
3. If the app is not executable after extraction, run `chmod +x VRCFaceTracking` in that folder.
4. Run `./VRCFaceTracking`.

Minimal distros also need `libice6` and `libsm6` installed.
